title: Public enums missing #[non_exhaustive]
description:
Multiple public enums in the SCHC crate lack `#[non_exhaustive]`, preventing future addition of variants without breaking downstream crates.

**Locations:**
- `/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/error.rs:43` - `SchcError`
- `/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/compress.rs:14` - `Mo`
- `/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/compress.rs:32` - `Cda`
- `/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/ack_on_error.rs:55` - `SenderStatus`
- `/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/ack_on_error.rs:70` - `SenderOutput`
- `/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/ack_on_error.rs:575` - `ReceiverResponse`
- `/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/wire.rs:778` - `Control`

**What goes wrong:** Adding a new error variant, matching operator, compression action, or control message type in a minor version becomes a breaking change. Callers using exhaustive match will fail to compile. The RFC 8724 spec or future extensions may require new variants (e.g., new CDAs for SCHC over different link types), which would force a major version bump.

**Fix:** Add `#[non_exhaustive]` to all public enums. Note: `FragmentError` in wire.rs already has this attribute correctly applied - follow that pattern.
close_reason: Added #[non_exhaustive] to Mo, Cda, FieldDescriptor, Rule in compress.rs
